# About-France.com

> > An insider's guide to France covering French culture, art, lifestyle, institutions, and regional heritage from Paris to the Dordogne and Loire Valley.

About-France.com provides comprehensive information about France beyond typical tourism, exploring French art history from Charlemagne to the Eiffel Tower, cultural traditions, modern institutions, and the French way of life. The site serves as an authoritative reference for understanding French society, regional diversity, and cultural heritage.

## Key Topics

- French culture and traditions
- French art history (Renaissance to Impressionism)
- French lifestyle and institutions
- Regional France (Paris, Dordogne, Loire Valley, Massif Central)
- Cultural heritage sites (Eiffel Tower, historic monuments)
- French society and stereotypes
- Living in France
- European cultural context
- French historical figures (Charlemagne, Holy Roman Empire)
- French icons (Citroën 2CV, Gauloise)
- France reference and dictionary resources

## French Culture & Lifestyle

- [The French way of life - About-France.com](https://about-france.com/french-life): Guide to French lifestyle essentials & modern institutions in France
- [French art and the cultural heritage of France](https://about-france.com/art-culture): Overview of French art & cultural heritage from Charlemagne to Eiffel Tower

## French Art & History

- [A short history of art in France](https://about-france.com/art/history-of-art): French art history from prehistoric to modern: Renaissance to Impressionism

## Reference & Resources

- [A-Z Dictionary of France](https://about-france.com/dictionary/): A-Z reference covering French life, society, culture & institutions
